evals.name: updated-scenario-old-approval
evals.prompt: Trace a bundle whose scenario changed after acceptance while its previous product review remains referenced. Generate no successful gate result without resolving the mismatch.
evals.expected_output: Detects the stale source hash or review revision, routes the issue to its owner, and does not bless or silently refresh acceptance.

evals.name: misleading-valid-link
evals.prompt: Trace a structurally valid graph where a scenario permitting all users to export cites a source that restricts export to administrators.
evals.expected_output: Detects semantic contradiction despite successful structural validation and returns a blocking finding with source evidence.
